insight: Toggling stance is no longer disabled by silence. This allows you to switch to the correct stance even when silenced, helping you survive until the silence ends so you can use abilities.
Infernal Shred now reduces armor percentage faster per attack. Own attacks build the debuff earlier, allowing more damage with Searing Arrows in early game even without skeleton count.
Talent change reduces Death Pact cooldown from 40 to 30 seconds at level 15. This 25% reduction accelerates farming significantly during mid-game farming phase.
Liquid Fire level 1 damage reduced from 100 to 75. Consider starting with Dual Breath instead to preserve mana, then buy extra mangoes to sustain through the laning stage.
Healing Ward cooldown increased by 7 seconds at level 1, translating to 14 max HP heal difference. Be more conservative in lane as you lose sustain equivalent to one tango charge.
Can now toggle stances during silence. Allows switching between Shogun and Katana stances even when silenced to maintain optimal damage output.
Catchy Lick pull distance increased for enemies only. This removes the double-edged sword aspect where allies could be pulled into danger, making it safer to pull in enemies.
Catchy Lick now grants 100 HP heal over 10 seconds on cast. With talent, becomes 325 heal that reapplies every 7 seconds, providing significant sustain in extended fights.
Croak of Genius duration no longer decreases when Largo uses own abilities. Provides extended mana cost reduction window while using abilities and moving around.
Croak of Genius no longer applies bonus reverb damage. Still provides mana cost reduction, but removes the 30-45% damage amplification that made it too easy to use on cores.
Entangle damage increased from 60 to 100 at level 1. With 1.2 second root duration, this is approximately 100 damage per root cast, significantly improving level 1 engage potential.
Savage Roar cooldown reduced at level 1. Improves aggressive trading frequency in early laning phase.
Bear bounty reduced. Players are still punished for losing the bear due to its long respawn cooldown, but killing it provides less reward. Reduces over-reliance on bear denial as a win condition.
Poof cast point increased to 0.3 seconds. Opponents now have more time to react, silence Meepos, or respond before instant repositioning.
Base armor increased by 1. Makes it even harder to harass out of lane due to existing free health manipulation.
Sanity Eclipse no longer deals bonus damage to illusions. This removes one-shot potential against illusion heroes and creates a new weakness for the hero.

Shield Crash barrier amount nerfed significantly. Compensated with buffs to movement speed, cast range, and ability cooldown. No longer provides 800+ barrier mid-fight; focus on all-around mobility and dps instead.
Base armor increased significantly. Helps survive early trades while relying on other buffed abilities rather than the nerfed barrier.
Agony now provides breakthrough immunity in addition to damage. In late-game teamfights where both sides have Black King Bar, breaking enemy debuff immunity becomes a significant tactical advantage.
Can now toggle abilities during silence. Minor quality of life improvement, continues trend of buffing the hero multiple patches in a row.

Increased maximum souls without requiring Agony purchase. Right-click Shadow Fiend no longer needs Agony and benefits from all farming scenarios. May see return of right-click builds over pure spellcaster.

Presence of the Dark Lord magic resistance reduction nerfed. Spellcaster Shadow Fiend with Blink and Hex will delete people slightly less effectively, encouraging more experimentation with right-click builds.

Anchor Smash talent changed to 50% less damage and now counts as reflection damage. Prevents infinite reflection loops with Blade Mail where procs would chain endlessly. Removes the broken build that reached 60% win rate.
Living Armor damage block increased from 195 to 270, with cooldown reduced by 6 seconds. Consider QW start to maximize early harass and frequent Living Armor casts for lane control.

Living Armor maxed damage block increased from 300 to 420 without talent, up to 560 with talent. At 10-20 minutes with max Living Armor, you block approximately one ultimate's worth of damage every 15 seconds.

Hero gains early game power but may still struggle late game as Living Armor damage block gets overwhelmed quickly. Win the early laning phase and push tempo before the hero falls off in extended teamfights.

Fury Swipes damage talent moved from level 15 to level 20. This delays the timing window when Battle Fury and Blink combo comes online with high damage multiplier, slowing acceleration into mid-game kills and farm.

Attack Speed talent moved from level 10 to level 15. Pushing the snowball build window back 5 levels significantly delays when Viper with Attack Speed build becomes oppressive, potentially killing the build's effectiveness.
